summary: Describes LISP, an experimental network-layer protocol that separates IP addresses into Endpoint Identifiers and Routing Locators. It requires no changes to host stacks or the Internet core and can be deployed gradually. It was replaced by RFC 9300 and RFC 9301.

eli5.summary: Your name stays the same even when you move house. A lookup service tells people your current address, so mail still finds you wherever you are.
